config.title: A Free Ghana
config.passage: Long ago, Ghana was ruled by Britain and was known as the Gold Coast. Many people wanted to govern their own country. Led by Kwame Nkrumah, they worked hard for their freedom. On 6 March 1957, Ghana became independent — the first country in sub-Saharan Africa to do so.
